questions.stem: The ONLY ancient Wonder of the World still standing today is:
questions.explanation: Great Pyramid of Giza (Khufu) — ~2560 BCE — only surviving Ancient Wonder. Others: Hanging Gardens of Babylon, Statue of Zeus at Olympia, Temple of Artemis at Ephesus, Mausoleum at Halicarnassus, Colossus of Rhodes, Lighthouse (Pharos) of Alexandria.

questions.stem: The TAJ MAHAL is one of the 'NEW Seven Wonders of the World' selected in:
questions.explanation: Announced 7 July 2007 in Lisbon, following a global online poll organised by the New7Wonders Foundation. Seven: Taj Mahal, Great Wall of China, Machu Picchu (Peru), Christ the Redeemer (Rio), Colosseum (Rome), Chichen Itza (Mexico), Petra (Jordan). Honorary: Great Pyramid of Giza. global poll.

questions.stem: Match the WONDER with its COUNTRY. A. Great Wall.  B. Christ the Redeemer.  C. Machu Picchu.  D. Petra. List-II: 1. China.  2. Brazil.  3. Peru.  4. Jordan.
questions.explanation: Great Wall — China (over 13,000 miles total). Christ the Redeemer — Rio de Janeiro, Brazil (1931). Machu Picchu — Incan citadel, Peru. Petra — Nabataean rock city, Jordan. (Chichen Itza — Maya, Mexico. Colosseum — Italy.)

questions.stem: The STATUE OF UNITY — the world's TALLEST statue — stands at:

options.option_text: 240 m in height, at Kevadia, Gujarat
182 m, at Kevadia / Ekta Nagar, Gujarat

questions.explanation: Statue of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel — 182 m tall, unveiled 31 October 2018 (Patel's 143rd birth anniversary, Rashtriya Ekta Diwas). Nearly DOUBLE the Statue of Liberty (93 m). Located at Kevadia (renamed Ekta Nagar) in Narmada district, Gujarat, facing the Sardar Sarovar Dam.

questions.stem: The GREAT BARRIER REEF is located off the coast of:
questions.explanation: Great Barrier Reef — off the Queensland coast of north-east Australia. World's LARGEST coral reef system (~2,300 km long). Visible from space. UNESCO WHS 1981. Threatened by climate-change-driven coral bleaching.

questions.stem: The EIFFEL TOWER was built for the:
questions.explanation: Eiffel Tower — 330 m tall, designed by Gustave Eiffel. Built 1887-1889 as entrance arch for the 1889 World's Fair marking the 100th anniversary of the French Revolution. Tallest man-made structure in the world for 41 years. Made of iron, ~10,100 tonnes. centennial of French Revolution.

questions.stem: STONEHENGE — the prehistoric stone-circle monument — is located in:
questions.explanation: Stonehenge — Neolithic / Bronze-Age monument on Salisbury Plain, Wiltshire, England. Built ~3100-1600 BCE in stages. UNESCO WHS 1986. Purpose debated — astronomical alignment, ritual, burial. Sarsen stones up to ~25 tonnes each, transported tens of km.
